title: Owner price-floor doctrine: retire 30/35% POC floors and use 5% POC sell-off red-line
owner_answer_verbatim: Q1 *** DOCTRINE CHANGE ***: OLD 30/35% POC floors are DEAD as floors. Sell-off mode declared: red-line = sell price preserving >=5% POC (profit on COGS). Raise ONLY offers currently below the 5%-POC floor ("yes do the increases of those prices and required changes"); do NOT restore 30/35% floors. Repricer batch must be REBUILT to min=5%-POC floor before apply (GO given for the corrected batch). Q11: one-way-up delegation APPROVED but REBASED to the NEW 5%-POC floors ("update the recommended approach and use it - I fully approve that").

scope.description: AB records the owner doctrine. Floor implementation and Repricer/Kaspi writes belong to the owning Web_automation lanes.

floor_policy.minimum_sell_price_semantics: sell price must preserve at least 5% POC profit on COGS
floor_policy.raise_policy: raise only offers currently below the 5% POC floor
floor_policy.forbidden_policy: do not restore 30% or 35% POC floors as mandatory floors without a new explicit owner decision

delegations.note: Approved only for correcting offers currently below the new 5% POC floor.
Reference-only in AB. Repricer batch must be rebuilt to min=5% POC before apply.

explicit_non_authorizations: This registry does not authorize AB to edit floor/pricing implementation files.
This registry does not authorize a Kaspi, Repricer, or merchant-account write from this repo.

reactivation_policy.override_requires: A future override must name this decision_id and state the replacement floor percentage, affected store scope, and implementation lane.
